correctness.rationale: Theorem 1.2 gives JP(P∩[sigma]) for every nonempty basic slice of a special P⊆GL1. Proposition A.2 applies to every class with JP and makes its generalized-low fibre at each A≥T 0' countably infinite. Applying it to each slice gives infinitely many distinct degrees locally. Since every B in P is GL1, the generalized-low condition is equivalent to B'≡T A. Density follows from the cylinder basis, and B≤T B'≡T A bounds the whole real fibre by the countably many A-computable reals.

value.rationale: The source explicitly identifies fibre structure as a natural direction. The accepted corollary supplies a nontrivial topological part of that structure: every jump degree above 0' is represented degree-infinitely often in every basic neighborhood of one fixed special GL1 class. This is stronger than global countable infinitude and makes the local Join Property visibly constrain the topology of every jump fibre.
